FIELD NOTES № 03
The Black Barn returns to the spring calendar.

After a quiet winter — new flooring, a re-pointed chimney, and a sea-tarnish coat fresh on the outer cladding — the barn lifts its shutters in time for the long evenings. Bookings open Monday.

Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we most often photograph at four in the afternoon — the precise hour when the cypress shadow falls into the courtyard like a poured drink, slow but knowing. This summer it returns to revisit with the bakery in Big Sur Village.
